senses.en_definition: The code word for the letter C in the international radiotelephony spelling alphabet.

messages.en: Charlie, are you here yet? I'm waiting outside the front of the shop.
Yeah, but it turns out I'm at the back entrance. Hang on, I'll walk round to the front.
I'm planning to go to China next month. Have you ever been?
Yeah, I've been to Beijing. Which city are you thinking of visiting?
Is the main character a CIA agent? I'm about to watch this movie.
Yeah, but watch it first. I don't want to spoil it for you.

senses.en_definition: A shortened form of encik, usually used as a title for an unmarried woman (Miss), or as a polite form of address to someone unfamiliar.
Small or young; a shortened form of kecik (kecil), chiefly retained in kinship terms.

messages.en: Miss, has my order arrived at the shop yet? If it has, I'd like to pick it up this afternoon.
Yes, it's here, sir. You can pick it up any time after two. Just show us your order number when you come.
